items.claim: Spacic lacks great pace and striking abilities.
items.quote: I don't think she's got great pace. I don't think she's got great striking abilities.

items.claim: Luciano has great cardio and maintains a high volume pace when opponents cannot take her down.
items.quote: Luciano does not tire. And when you cannot take her down, she really puts up a high volume pace fight.

items.claim: Luciano struggles against bigger, stronger physical fighters who can rough her up and take her down.
items.quote: It's the against bigger, stronger physical fighters that can rough her up and take her down is where she has troubles.

items.claim: Luciano showed an improved ground game and offensive takedowns in her fight against Rava Olivera.
items.quote: You saw her improved ground game. Now she's offensively getting takedowns

items.claim: Marina Spassich lost to a 5-2 regional fighter two fights ago.
items.quote: She lost to a 5-2 regional fighter just two fights ago.
